summary: Compile an explicitly authored, bounded monophonic semantic score into a reproducible MIDI file.
requires: Mido >=1.3 for MIDI export; standard library for validation
A writable local path; no network or Suno credentials
inputs: One v0 score JSON with explicit notes and human-authored intent, up to 64 KiB
An optional expected destination for MIDI
outputs: Standard MIDI Format 0 file with exact validated notes and tempo/meter
JSON receipt with input/output hashes, note count, range, duration and rest

enforced: Exact 480 ticks/quarter note fractions; no hidden quantization
Only major or natural minor, no chromatic alterations/polyphony
Existing output with different content cannot be replaced
Reject unsupported fields, overlapping notes, failed constraints
operator: User/agent supplies explicit notes and owns creative interpretation
No upload, Suno generation, credit use or third-party copying
MIDI correctness does not imply Suno audio or listener fidelity

stop_when: Score is rejected with a specific error
Valid MIDI and receipt are written or identical existing MIDI is verified
Required Mido dependency is not installed; do not invent an output file
